source.adoption: User requested Nigel taglines become canonical; new PPTX and PDF version 19.
source.wording: Verbatim from saved slide-title placeholders; no copy edits.

changes.previous: Slow demand growth and greater import reliance set the baseline; power, refineries and routes could change it
changes.canonical: Slow demand growth and greater import reliance set the baseline; however, trajectories of power generation, refineries and the route to market could change it

changes.previous: Vopak can capture inland growth through the Durban–Lesedi corridor, with expansion conditional on turnover and returns
changes.canonical: Vopak can capture inland growth through the Durban–Lesedi corridor, with capacity expansion conditional on turnover and return on investment

changes.previous: Capturable volumes, route competitiveness and tank turnover determine the investment required
changes.canonical: Capturable volumes, route competitiveness and storage turnover determine the investment required

changes.previous: Nine demand–supply worlds test the investment choice against the Medium / Medium baseline
changes.canonical: We define the South Africa liquids fuel market across demand–supply worldviews that test investment choices against a set of levers and outcomes

changes.previous: Petrol demand has declined while diesel has grown slowly, limiting the case for demand-led expansion
changes.canonical: Petrol demand has declined while diesel has grown slowly, limiting the case for demand-led expansion outlook

changes.previous: Power shortages and road freight have supported diesel consumption, but that support can change
changes.canonical: Power shortages and road freight have supported diesel consumption, but that support can change with increased support for rail reform and improved Eskom

changes.previous: Lower domestic production has increased imports and shifted how inland demand is supplied
changes.canonical: The shut down of domestic refining capacity has lowered domestic production and has increased imports shifting how inland demand is supplied

changes.previous: Domestic sources and competing gateways contest the same inland customers
changes.canonical: With increased imports and constrained domestic capacity, alternative gateways compete for the same inland customers

changes.previous: Higher turnover could let Durban and Lesedi serve more demand through existing tanks
changes.canonical: Increasing asset utilisation through higher turnover could let Durban and Lesedi serve more demand through existing tanks and corridor growth opportunities

changes.previous: Rail recovery, EV adoption and efficiency could reduce transport fuel demand
changes.canonical: Accelerated rail recovery, EV adoption and ICE technology efficiency could reduce transport fuel demand in the medium to long term

changes.previous: Power recovery could lower diesel use further, while outages and replacement delays could reverse the gains
changes.canonical: Power generation recovery could lower diesel use further, while outages and replacement delays could sustain domestic demand

changes.previous: Changes in delivered cost and reliability could shift inland flows between competing corridors
changes.canonical: Competitive offering on delivered cost and reliability could shift inland flows between competing corridors and strengthen growth in adjacent markets (landlocked SADC)

changes.previous: Expansion requires capturable throughput beyond achievable capacity at an adequate return
changes.canonical: Capital allocation requires capturable throughput beyond achievable capacity and sustainable commercial terms
